# `aitbc config edit`

Open the configuration file in the default editor.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc config edit [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--global` | flag | `false` | no | Edit global config |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc config edit
```
